limitations: Finite matched analytical problem on every whole declared geometry; not a literature figure reproduction.
Finite divergence/bubble rank and normal constraints do not establish a uniform inf-sup estimate.
Original residuals are Euclidean norms of physical weak equation rows, separate from physical L2 field errors.
Coherent bubble replay preserves actual acquired solution/geometry/operator, inverse-maps coordinates into original rows; it does not reassemble or solve a new rotated saddle.
Costs cover full owned process on a shared host; no controlled speedup claim.
